name: Napa & Sonoma
summary: America's most famous wine country — valley after valley of vineyards, tasting rooms, a wine train, and Calistoga's mud baths and geyser.

foodMustTry.name: A long wine-country lunch
foodMustTry.blurb: World-class food to match the wine (Oxbow Market for something casual).

item.title: Napa Valley wineries & the Wine Train
item.blurb: Tasting-room hop up the valley (Castello di Amorosa's castle is a fun stop) or ride the Napa Valley Wine Train.
gear: a designated driver or a tour

days.label: Day 456 — Sonoma & Calistoga
days.summary: The plaza and the spa town.

item.title: Sonoma Plaza & Calistoga
item.blurb: The historic mission-and-plaza town of Sonoma, then Calistoga's mud baths and the Old Faithful Geyser of California.

days.label: Day 457 — East to Lake Tahoe
days.summary: Up into the Sierra to the great lake.

commute.scenicNote: East across the Central Valley and up to Tahoe.
